Hymn 140: Did You Think to Pray?
Time Signature: 6/8
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: William O. Perkins
Lyricist/Text Author: Mary A. Pepper Kidder
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 140 titled "Did You Think to Pray?" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 6/8 time signature. 
The music was composed by William O. Perkins and the lyrics were written by Mary A. Pepper Kidder.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
